name: step-slider
title: Step Slider
description: A slider with a few fixed stops marked as dots, a snapping knob and a spinning action button.

perf.budget: The knob and dots are driven by one shared value on the UI thread; React re-renders only when the stop changes.

a11y.reducedMotion: The knob snaps without overshoot and the action icon does not spin.
a11y.screenReader: Adjustable role reading the stop name (or "Step 2 of 4"); increment and decrement move one stop.
a11y.touchTarget: The track is 44 pt tall; the action button is 44 pt.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add step-slider`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
